mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate indicates monetary easing, which can lead to increased borrowing and investment, thereby driving up S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases but S&P 500 returns are negative over the next 20 days more than 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate signals a strong labor market, which may boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decreases by 0.2pp in one month
failure_condition: If UNRATE decreases but S&P 500 returns are negative over the next 20 days more than 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in payroll employment and a decline in unemployment rate indicates a robust labor market, which may lead to increased economic activity and higher S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If both PAYEMS and UNRATE improve but S&P 500 returns are negative over the next 60 days more than 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in GDP indicates economic growth, which may lead to higher corporate revenues and thus positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 increases but S&P 500 returns are negative over the next 60 days more than 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production suggests increased economic activity, which may lead to higher S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases but S&P 500 returns are negative over the next 20 days more than 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the consumer price index indicates inflation, which may lead to higher interest rates and thus negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL increases by 0.5% in one month
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL increases but S&P 500 returns are positive over the next 20 days more than 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in housing starts and retail sales suggest strong consumer demand, which may lead to higher S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If both HOUST and RSAFS increase but S&P 500 returns are negative over the next 60 days more than 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate combined with high federal funds rate suggests a late-cycle expansion, which may lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days due to potential monetary tightening.
failure_condition: If UNRATE is low and FEDFUNDS are high but S&P 500 returns are positive over the next 20 days more than 40% of the time.
